output_list.criticism: The winner will receive more than the total bounty. The owner will receive less than the total bounty. The total bounty is calculated as totalBounty = ticketPrice * numtickets. The winner will receive totalBounty - ownerTax. The ownerTax is calculated as 6 * totalBounty / 100. The totalBounty is not reduced by the ownerTax before the winner receives the bounty. The winner will receive more than the total bounty. The owner will receive less than the total bounty.
